Details / Function: Main microcontroller for processing motion sensor data and sending BLE mouse cursor commands
6-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) for wrist motion and rotation tracking
Physical input buttons for left-click (SW1), right-click (SW2), and cursor activation (SW3)
Master power switch (SW4) between battery supply and circuit
Visual status indicator LED (D1) for power/operational state
2-pin header connector (J1) to connect the 3.7V LiPo battery
Current-limiting resistor (R1) for status LED D1
Pull-up resistors (R2, R3) for I²C SDA and SCL lines
Rechargeable 3.7V 400mAh LiPo battery for wearable power
Decoupling capacitors (C1, C2) for MPU-6050 VDD and VLOGIC power lines
Charge-pump filter capacitor (C3) for MPU-6050 CPOUT pin
Internal regulator filter capacitor (C4) for MPU-6050 REGOUT pin
